targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, vacuumalarm__value AS vacuumalarm FROM marpower__380000_seawater ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('vacuumalarm') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS vacuumalarm_tag FROM marpower__io_metadata WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/380000-seawater';

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp AS time, cool_pmp_1_remote__value AS pmp1_remote, cool_pmp_1_running__value AS pmp1_running, cool_pmp_2_remote__value AS pmp2_remote, cool_pmp_2_running__value AS pmp2_running FROM marpower__380000_seawater ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('cool_pmp1_startstop') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS pmp1_startstop_tag, MAX(CASE WHEN mqtt_json_path = LOWER('cool_pmp2_startstop') THEN '(' || yard_tag || ')' ELSE NULL END) AS pmp2_startstop_tag FROM marpower__io_metadata WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/380000-seawater';

SELECT timestamp as time, vacuumalarm__value AS vacuum_alarm, cool_pmp_1_remote__value AS cooling_pump_1_remavail, cool_pmp_1_running__value AS cooling_pump_1_running, cool_pmp_2_remote__value AS cooling_pump_2_remavail, cool_pmp_2_running__value AS cooling_pump_2_running, cool_pmp_1_startstop__value AS cooling_pump_1_onoff, cool_pmp_2_startstop__value AS cooling_pump_2_onoff FROM marpower__380000_seawater WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC;
SELECT timestamp as time, flow__value AS flow FROM marpower__380000_seawater WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (topic) topic, alarm__value AS Alarm, close__value AS Close, closed__value AS Closed, hmi_cmd_close__value AS HmiCmdClose, hmi_cmd_open__value AS HmiCmdOpen, hmi_control_available__value AS HmiControlAvailable, open__value AS Open, opened__value AS Opened, should_be_open__value AS ShouldBeOpen, timestamp FROM marpower__380000_seawater_cooling WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY topic, timestamp DESC;
